about_the_game:
THE NEW RPG OF ADVENTURE AND SURVIVAL IN A WILD, MYTHICAL WORLD

Dare to cross the polar wall, adventurer, and step into a land forgotten by time. The island of Elysium awaits — a living world where every step brings discovery, every creature hides a secret, and every decision leaves its mark.

• An open world filled with mystery and ancient ruins
Explore a vast, ever-changing land of haunted forests, crumbling temples, and places where nature has reclaimed its throne. Along your journey, you'll uncover fragments of a story lost to wind and stone.

• Survival, crafting, and blacksmithing as the core of your progress
Gather resources, build tools, and forge your own weapons at the smithy. Every piece of gear you craft carries unique traits that shape your playstyle. Will you fight as a hardened warrior, move like an agile rogue, or strike with magic? You can even mix gear types to create your own class.
     

• Strategic combat built on training and adaptation
Victory doesn’t rely on reflexes, but on preparation. Your character fights autonomously, but their effectiveness depends on how well you've trained with each weapon type. Understanding each enemy’s strengths, weaknesses, and elemental affinities is key to survival. Sharpen your mind, refine your technique, and let your preparation speak on the battlefield.

     

• Freedom to forge your own path
Develop your character your way — from a stealthy hunter to a brute-force warrior or a wise conjurer. Your choices, allies, and actions will shape your destiny.

 

• A fragmented narrative woven through myth and legend
In Elysium, every ruin whispers a secret, and every encounter reveals echoes of long-lost civilizations — perhaps more than one. The story isn’t told to you; you uncover it yourself, piece by piece, as you explore what remains of a world that once was.

Forge your legend. Survive the wild. Discover the forgotten.
This is not just your journey… it’s the story you’ll leave behind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows
  • Processor: Dual-core 64-bit
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Pixel shader 5.0 capable card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Explore a mythical island beyond the polar ice wall in this open-world RPG. Craft weapons, hunt wild creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and survive in a living world that evolves with each update. A journey shaped by nature, discovery, and danger.
